sentences.text: Cooper is on day 46 of 56 of a Royal Canin HP trial and has been eating the trial food, with chicken on 29 of 154 meals and treats and at least 4 off-list feedings.
Itching was logged on 16 of 43 logged days, 3 entries in the first week and 0 in the latest 4 d logged; the record is not a test of the diet.
Apoquel 16 mg once daily, prescribed Apr 30: doses not logged.
